entities.name: Johannes von Kuhn
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johannes Evangelist von Kuhn was a German Catholic theologian. With Franz Anton Staudenmaier he occupied the foremost rank among the speculative dogmatists of the Catholic Tübingen school.
